newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAMFELT SEES GOOD EARNINGS FOR 1997.
newsitem.headline: TAMFELT SEES GOOD EARNINGS FOR 1997.

text.p: Finnish paper manufacturing equipment supplier Tamfelt Oy Ab said in a statement on Thursday it expects its 1997 earnings to be good.
"This year's result is expected to remain good," Tamfelt said.
Tamfelt's 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax rose to 99 million markka from 76 million in 1995.

Tamfelt said its board would propose to the annual general meeting on April 3 that Tamfelt's company bylaws be changed so that an ordinary share could be converted to a preferred share at a shareholder's request. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
